content: Seremaia nan Pwoahr Loal ehu
Sepataia, nein Mattan, Kedalaia, nein Pasuhr, Seukal, nein Selemaia, oh Pasuhr, nein Malkaia, irail ahpw rongada dahme I kin padahkihong aramas akan. I kin padahkihong irail

dahme KAUN-O ketin mahsaniher: “Mehmen me pahn mihmihte nan kahnimw wet pahn mehla nan mahwen, de pahn mehkihla lehk lapalap de soumwahu. Ahpw mehmen me pahn tangala rehn mehn Papilonia kan sohte pahn mehla; e ahpw pahn pitla oh sohte pahn kamakamala.”
I pil padahkihong irail me KAUN-O pil ketin mahsanih, “I pahn kihong kahnimw wet karis en Papilonia, oh re pahn kalowehdi.”

Lapalap ako eri patohwanohng nanmwarkio, “Ohl menet konehng en kamakamala. Pwehki soangen mahsen pwukat, e kahrehiong sounpeien kahnimw wet ar nan kapehd tikitiklahr, oh e pil wiewiahiong aramas koaros me luwehdi nan kahnimw wet soahngohte. Ohl menet sohte nsenohki kamwahupen aramas akan, pwe kauparailte me e inengieng.”
Nanmwarki Sedekaia eri mahsanih, “Eri, me mwahu! Kumwail wiahiong nsenamwail; I sohte kak iredihsang kumwail.”
Irail eri koliehdi oh apihiehdi nan en sapwellime pwutak, Malkaia pwoahr ehu, me mi nan kelen tehnpaso. Sohte pihl nan pwoahro, ihte pwelmatak, ngehi eri suhrla loale.
A Epedmelek, mehn Sudan men, me lekwusol, e kin doadoahk nan tehnpesen nanmwarkio, ahpw rongada duwen ar keseiehdi nan pwoahro. Ni ahnsowo, nanmwarkio ketiket ni Ewen Kelen Pensamin, wiewia kopwung.
Epedmelek eri patohla wasao oh patohwanohng nanmwarkio,
“Maing, Wasa Lapalap, me sapwung dahme aramas pwukat wiadahr. Re kesediong Seremaia nan pwoahro, wasa e pahn duhpekla ie oh mehla. Pwe solahr kisin tungoal nan kahnimw wet.”
Nanmwarkio eri mahsanihong Epedmelek en kahrehda ohl silimen me mi wasao oh re en kohla apihiedahsang nan pwoahro, pwe I en dehr mehla.
Epedmelek oh ohl ako ahpw patohla wasahn nahk dipwisou en tehnpaso oh ale pelien likou mering kei me e kihong ni sahl oh kadardilahng rehi nan pwoahro.
Ih eri ndaiong ie I en kihong likou mering ko pahn pehi kat, pwe sahlo dehr kauweiehla. Ngehi eri kapwaiada,
oh irail ahpw apihiehda sang nan pwoahro. Mwurin met, I ahpw mihmihte nan kehlo.
Sedekaia Peki Kaweid rehn Seremaia
Nanmwarki ahpw malipeiehdo ni kesiluhn wenihmwen Tehnpas Sarawio. E ahpw mahsanihong ie, “I pahn wiahiong komwi peidek ehu, oh I sohte men komwi en ekihsang ie mehkot.”
Ngehi eri sapeng, patohwan, “Ma I pahn pato mehlel ong komwi, a komw pahn ketin kemeiehla; a ma I pahn kaweid komwi, komw sohte pahn ketin kupwurohki.”
Nanmwarki Sedekaia eri ketin inoukihong ie ni rir, mahsanih, “Ni mwaren Koht ieias, me ketikidohng kitail mour, I sohte pahn kemeiukala, I sohte pil pahn panguhkala rehn aramas me men kemeiukala.”

Ngehi eri patohwanohng Sedekaia me KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, Koht en Israel, ketin mahsanih, “Ma komw pahn peki mahk rehn lapalap akan en nanmwarkien Papilonia, komw pahn kapitala omwi mour, oh kahnimw wet sohte pahn lulda. Komwi oh omwi peneinei pahn momourte.
A ma komw sohte pahn peki mahk, eri, kahnimw wet pahn kohieng mehn Papilonia kan, me pahn isikala, oh komw sohte pahn pitsang irail.”
A Nanmwarki Sedekaia ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “I masak mehlel mehn Suhs ako me tangasang kitail oh mihla rehn mehn Papilonia kan. I perki I de pengpenglahng rehrail, re ahpw pahn kaloke ie kowahlap.”

I ahpw patohwan, “Komw sohte pahn pengpengla rehrail. I patohwan peki rehmwi, maing, komwi en ketin kapwaiada mahsen en KAUN-O duwen me I patopatohwanohng komwi; mehkoaros ahpw pahn pweida mwahu rehmwi, oh omwi mour pahn poadoandoarla.
Pwe KAUN-O me ketin kasalehiongieier nan kaudiahl ehu dahme pahn pweida ma komw sohte pahn peki mahk.
A iet! Lih koaros me luwehdi nan tehnpesen nanmwarkien Suda, re pakapakahr kolahng rehn lapalap en nanmwarkien Papilonia kan. Komw karonge dahme re ndinda kohla:

content.text: A met, ni aluweluwe kan eh suhrlahr nan pwelmatak,

content: I ahpw pil patohwanohng, “Noumwail lih akan oh seri kan koaros pahn pakahrlahng rehn mehn Papilonia kan, oh komwi sohte pahn kak pitla. Komwi pahn selidi oh pakahrlahng rehn nanmwarkien Papilonia oh kahnimw wet pahn lulda, wiahla pehs.”
Sedekaia ahpw sapeng, mahsanih, “Ke dehpa mweseiseikihong emen ata koasoi, pwe iei me ke pahn pitkihsang mehla.
Ma lapalap akan pahn esehda ata koasoi, re uhdahn pahn idek rehmw audepen koasoi wet. Re pahn inoukihong uhk me re sohte pahn kemeiukala, ma ke pahn kasalehda mehkoaros.
Ke pahn ndaiong irail me ke ale pekipek rehi I en dehr kadaruhkalahng nan imwetengo pwe ke pahn mehla ie.”

Eri, lapalap koaros ahpw pwarodo rehi. Re idek rehi mehkoaros, a I sapengkin irail duwehte me nanmwarki mahsanihong ie I en sapengki. Eri, re ahpw sohte kak wia mehkot, pwehki sohte emen rehrail rongada at koasoi ko.
Ngehi eri mihmihte nan kehlo lao lel rahn me Serusalem lohdi.
